correctness.rationale: Reconstructed all 36,069 augmented faces, 218,036 incidence relations and 18,024 matching pairs; verified entire reversed Hasse DAG acyclic. The 12-by-9 integral Morse boundary has six unit Smith factors and three zero factors. Exact enumeration gives four positive-oriented seven-vertex simplices fixed by each of six nonidentity rotations; reduced Lefschetz trace equals 3. A 3-dimensional rational C7 module must be trivial; Lefschetz rules out the 6-dimensional augmentation alternative in H4. Integral freeness upgrades rational action to the identity; rational transfer gives quotient Betti groups. All steps derive from packaged checker and standard proofs.

value.rationale: The original cycle-complete-product article specifically singles out C7×K4 as an exceptional example with two neighboring nonzero homology degrees and asks about torsion. The finding identifies the complete integral rotation action, an intrinsic symmetry invariant invisible to all nonequivariant wedge or Betti data, and gives nontrivial rational quotient topology: all nine positive-degree classes survive the order-seven cyclic quotient. A cyclotomic degree-four action was a genuine algebraic alternative before the fixed-face calculation; this is a motivated symmetry boundary rather than a parameter increment or known-rank restatement.
